subject: general
question: Why are carbon compounds bad conductors of electricity?

options.text: Because they don't form any ions
Because carbon compounds are solid in nature
Because they are ionic in nature
Because they have high melting and boiling point

solution:
The correct answer is __**Because they don't form any ions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Carbon compounds don't have a free electron that is required for electricity transfer thus making them bad conductors.
